verified_target_decision.reason: The S39 freeze and runtime gates accept any absolute regular-file path and independently require the fixed byte count and complete SHA; no canonical-directory predicate exists.

serial_steps.name: attempt4_terminal_gate
requires: actual size and SHA equal expected

serial_steps.name: prepare_frozen_core
serial_steps.command: python3 -B freeze_manifest.py prepare --vmem <verified attempt4 target> --clip <verified CLIP path> --vae-directory <fixed ft-mse directory> --out <fresh freeze_attempt_N>

serial_steps.name: attach_reviews
serial_steps.command: python3 -B freeze_manifest.py attach-reviews --core <core_path> --core-sha256 <core_file_sha256> --source-review <path> --source-review-sha256 <file SHA> --runtime-freeze <path> --runtime-freeze-sha256 <file SHA> --out <fresh review_attachment_N>

sha_semantics.core_file_sha256: SHA-256 of manifest_core.json bytes; pass to attach-reviews --core-sha256
sha_semantics.core_sha256: Canonical JSON SHA excluding review_receipts; place in both core review JSON files and carry into S40
sha_semantics.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of final attached manifest bytes; pass to metadata gate, loader, and S40 loading_manifest binding
sha_semantics.review_file_sha256: SHA-256 of each completed review JSON; pass to attach or downstream evidence binding

different_author_requirements: Two distinct reviewers must separately approve the actual frozen core as source/core review and runtime-freeze review.
A reviewer different from the actual loading executor must review the four loading evidence files.
S40 later requires two reviews bound to its own actual frozen core; source-only historical reviews do not authorize it.
